evals.name: anti-slop-landing
evals.prompt: Our new landing page looks templated and AI-generated. Audit first, then redesign with a one-line Design Read.
evals.expected_output: Brief inference, Design Read line, contextual rules only — not dashboard/table patterns.
assertions: Outputs a Design Read before generating UI
Audit-first on redesign not blind rewrite
Does not apply numbered 01/02/03 markers unless content is sequential
Stays in landing/portfolio scope not admin tables

evals.name: reject-dashboard
evals.prompt: Use design-taste-frontend on the inventory admin dashboard with DataTable and charts.
evals.expected_output: Skill explicitly excludes dashboards — use shadcn, layout-typography, tanstack-table instead.
assertions: Acknowledges skill is not for dashboards or data tables
Routes to Luxe admin stack skills
